keyframe_review.note: New keyframe. 'New Brunswick was formed from the partition of Sunbury County from the remainder of Nova Scotia'; the page gives the province's area as 72,908 km2; the gazetteer's New Brunswick is 67,524 km2 (ratio 0.93). The Maine boundary (St. Croix, Madawaska) is not on the page; the Sunbury County of 1765 had reached the Penobscot (Nova Scotia page).
